audience: Mexican businesses that issue CFDI invoices from their Facture App account

useCases.title: Check the issuers and branches before you stamp
useCases.text: List the issuers on the account and their branches. Each branch id is the branch that stamps an invoice.

useCases.title: Review the invoices issued this period
useCases.text: List the invoices issued from the account with their folio, series, total and cancelled flag. Get one stamped invoice by its fiscal UUID to read its totals.

useCases.title: Look up clients and products in the catalog
useCases.text: List the clients with their RFC, tax regime and address. List the products and services with their unit prices and SAT keys.

useCases.title: Add a client or a product to the catalog
useCases.text: Create a client with its RFC, tax regime, CFDI use and fiscal address. Create a product or service with a unit price in MXN. Neither one stamps an invoice.

useCases.title: Stamp an invoice after the user confirms every field
useCases.text: Stamp one CFDI invoice from a Facture JSON document through a branch. This issues a real tax invoice with the SAT and uses Facture credits.

useCases.title: Cancel a stamped invoice with the SAT
useCases.text: Cancel one stamped invoice. Reason 01 needs the UUID of the replacement invoice, and reasons 02 to 04 need none. The reply says when the receiver must approve.
